evidence.quote: International citizenship from outside the EU/EEC THI charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester (for Bachelor’s programmes).
From summer term 2026, Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt (THI) charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester for Bachelor and 1.200 euros per semester for Master students from third countries*
2. PRIMUSS – THI application portal: from 2 May until 15 July for the winter semester

1. uni-assist: from as soon as possible until 30 May the latest for the winter semester If you obtained your higher secondary school certificate outside of Germany, uni-assist has to verify your eligibility to study in Germany and to convert school grades to the German grading system.
If the qualification for admission to higher education was obtained abroad, a preliminary assessment of the qualification by uni-assist is required.

Prerequisite for admission to study at Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt is either a general or subject-related higher education entrance qualification or the entrance qualification for studies at universities of applied sciences.

note.fr: Procédure de sélection : analyse du dossier (moyenne du baccalauréat et notes en mathématiques et informatique) ; un score total d'au moins 70 points est requis pour être invité à un entretien de sélection en ligne.
note.en: Selection procedure: review of certificates (overall average of the secondary school certificate and grades in mathematics and computer science); a total score of at least 70 points is required to be invited to a short online selection interview.

evidence.quote: Applicants who have achieved a total score of 70 points or more will be invited to a short online selection interview.

note.fr: Un entretien de sélection est obligatoire ; il dure environ 10 minutes par candidat et peut être individuel ou en groupe.
note.en: A selection interview is required; it lasts approximately 10 minutes per applicant and may be conducted individually or in groups.

evidence.quote: As part of the selection process, applicants are also required to pass a selection interview. This interview may be conducted individually or in groups and typically lasts approximately 10 minutes per applicant.

notes: Tuition: the programme page states 'THI charges tuition fees of 800 euros per semester (for Bachelor’s programmes)' for 'International citizenship from outside the EU/EEC'; the institution-wide fee page confirms 800 euros per semester for Bachelor students from third countries from summer term 2026. For a Moroccan applicant, the winter-semester application runs in two steps: uni-assist (foreign school-leaving certificate review / VPD) then PRIMUSS. The PRIMUSS deadline (15 July) stated for 'the winter semester' was taken as the recurring deadline for international applicants as the same page requires a VPD from uni-assist for foreign certificates.
